code_expire_days.description: 邀请码过期天数 (0=永不过期)

server_ip.description: 服务器信息 (由节点上报)

enable.description: 是否启用 (节点端是否运行)

group_id.description: 所属订阅分组 (如果为空则跟随节点)

transport.description: 传输层: tcp, ws, grpc, quic, h2

priority.description: 优先级 (数值越大优先级越高)

encryption.description: 加密: 空 或 mlkem768x25519plus

flow.description: VLESS 特有配置 (对应 V2bX flow, encryption, encryption_settings)

name.description: 模板名称 (显示给用户的节点名)

protocol_settings.description: 协议特定配置 (存储其他不在通用字段中的配置)

reality_public_key.description: Reality 配置 (当 TLS=2 时使用, 对应 V2bX tls_settings)

server.description: 服务器基础配置 (对应 V2bX CommonNode)

ss_cipher.description: Shadowsocks 配置 (对应 V2bX cipher, server_key)

tls.description: TLS 配置 (对应 V2bX tls 字段)

tls_fingerprint.description: TLS 指纹 (chrome, firefox, safari, ios, android, edge, 360, qq, random)

transport.description: 传输层配置 (对应 V2bX network, network_settings)

type.description: 协议类型: vmess, vless, trojan, shadowsocks, hysteria2, tuic, anytls

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and JWT token.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
